description: This Java class defines a validator for message header timeout values, parsing CharSequence inputs to longs and validating if they represent a valid duration in seconds. It throws an exception if validation fails.

classes.name: MessageHeaderTimeoutValueValidator
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractHeaderValueValidator that validates if a CharSequence represents a valid timeout duration in seconds.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of the validator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates that the given CharSequence in the header definition can be parsed to a long and represents a valid duration in seconds; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: parseLong
methods.description: Parses the CharSequence to a long value; assumes prior validation that the value is a valid long.
